notes.title: Development Update: April
notes.content:
Hey all!

Another month already? Feels like they're flying by!
I'm gonna be upfront, not a lot of things were done this month, due to some personal things, like moving house!

So that didn't give me a lot of time to work on Fever.
BUT! We still have some things we can show you all, mostly some new QOL updates, and Accessibility Options!

So let's just get right into it!

[h1][b]Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h1]

We're working on a ton of new Quality of Life updates! Here some previews:
[h2][b]New Marvellous Hit Effect Sprites[/b][/h2]
We updated the Marvellous hit effect sprite to better match the colour of the Marvellous text!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/65f16ca57a64f899f08af2a7c42ec8e0c35c91c9.png[/img]

[h2][b]Button Sprite Changes[/b][/h2]
The current sprite for buttons, while it matches thematically with the game, it can sometimes look odd, or hard to read, for this reason, we are experimenting with new sprites for buttons, that make it easier to read. 
[b]THIS IS NOT THE FINAL VERSION OF THE SPRITE[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/2cca712b51dc85e2b5a2d45c4abc3d77bded29b0.png[/img]

[b][h1]Accessibility[/h1][/b]

Circular Fever aims to be easy to pick up and play for everyone, so we're working on some features to make it easier for some.

[h2][b]Colourblind Modes[/b][/h2]
We're working on colourblind modes, so that those with colourblindness will be able to play with no difficulties!

[h2][b]Dark Mode[/b][/h2]
is Circular Fever too bright? Turn on Dark Mode for a darker way to play! With Dark UI, and Dark Note sprites! Coming to a Steam Store near you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/bd5e1c954927d1cf08e7e6fb06d2c4fd81e14522.png[/img]

[h2][b]Input Latency[/b][/h2]
Do your devices have too much input delay? Is it preventing you from mastering every song? Well fret not! We're working on a way for you to add latency to your inputs, so that the effect of input delay is mitigated!

[b][h1]and... That's a Wrap![/h1][/b]
And that's it!
You're all caught up with the Development Updates from April!

I only have one question... What's up with this monitor..?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/4d28a441f9790da2b1bf5f24420af66217b2535e.png[/img]

notes.title: Circular Fever Development Update: March
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I'm Excelior, the lead developer of Circular Fever!

March has been a crazy month for Circular Fever, with major progress in all fronts! I'm not gonna make you wait any longer, let's get into it!

[h1][b]MUSIC[/b][/h1]

Last month, I mentioned how previous songs from OST 1, specifically the ones featured in the Demo (except Retrograde) would be getting a little remix. As of yesterday, the first song to get remixed: Fever Power, was finished! What great timing! Check it out:
[previewyoutube=YE-PunEnWfw;full][/previewyoutube]

We're still working on Manic Madness, another song featured in the Demo, so stay tuned for that!

[b][h1]DEMO UPDATES[/h1][/b]

Speaking of the Demo, it's pretty outdated compared to the current beta of Fever, so we've decided to update the Demo! This is still a little while away, as we have more songs to remix, and levels to rechart, but it'll be updated within the next few months!

[h1][b]GAME UPDATES[/b][/h1]

Well, here it is, the part you've all been waiting for. What progress has been made on the actual game this month? Well, quite a lot! Let's just get into it:

[h2][b]REWORKS[/b][/h2]

The major reworks I mentioned last month have been completed! This is a major step in the games development and brings us one BIG step closer to releasing. I can't exactly show off what changed, since it isn't exactly noticeable in gameplay, but is a major change when making levels, and overall, helps make sure the level stays on time with the song.
While it's great having these mechanics, what does this actually matter if we don't use them?

[h2][b]LEVEL EDITOR[/b][/h2]

In April, We'll begin working on a level editor! At first, this will be private for the charters of Circular Fever, but eventually, it'll be public for everyone to use! It'll be available through Steam later this year.

[h2][b]SNEAK PEEKS[/b][/h2]

Now for a couple sneak peeks that don't need their own category!
(all footage shown here is taken from an early build in development, everything is subject to change!)

We've been working on new animations for each judgement! This includes the combo number above the sprite and how many milliseconds late/early you were when hitting the note!
[previewyoutube=qpkMDuK6NrY;full][/previewyoutube]

Bored of the set scroll speed of each level? Well now you can customise the scroll speed of each level! Take a little look at this example:
[previewyoutube=-t2Ot_WDQhI;full][/previewyoutube]

The menu has also recieved a redesign! (this is still a pretty early design, but its a good proof of concept!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/1645fad8c2caae39ee6fac9154bf0234169d5dad.png[/img]

[b][h1]AND THAT'S A WRAP![/h1][/b]

Thanks for reading! We've made a lot of progress this month! Granted, slow progress, but it's going well so far.

From the Circular Fever Development Team, we hope you have / had a great easter this year!
We'll see you next month!

notes.title: Circular Fever Developer Update: February
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Everyone![/b][/h1]

I'm Excelior, the lead developer of Circular Fever!

It's been a little while since our last post, and that's for good reason! We've been working hard on Circular Fever throughout this month, and although work has been slow but steady, we ARE making progress, and I am ready to show you guys a little sneak peek at what we've been up to.

This is the start of monthly devlogs that will basically be a quick summary of what we did this month, and will be posted on the first of every month for the prior month (eg: March 1st = February Devlog)

So let's get started!

[h1][b]MUSIC[/b][/h1]

We've been working on refreshing the OST, as mentioned in our last post, and we have made some progress!
First of all, we've decided on a song count! OST 1 will be available at launch, and will contain 8 songs! 
[i]You might have seen a little sneak peek of OST 1's selection in the Demo.[/i]

Most of these are completely new tracks, however, you may remember that in our last update, I mentioned that the current songs have been pretty hit or miss. I honestly agree. 
Those songs were made by me, and I'm not the best at making songs, but we now have a proper composer, who is actually skilled at music!

We haven't finalised this yet, but we're either gonna start working to remix some of the songs to sound way better, or we're gonna scrap them.
[b]once again, this has not been finalised yet.[/b]

Anyway, enough of the explaining what's been going on with the music, I know what you want. You want a preview of one of our songs!
Well I'll do you one better, how about a full song AND a preview of another song!

The full song is Birds and Bees! This will be used [strike]in the sho-[/strike] somewhere in the main menu!
[i]yeah.. that's not finished yet, you're gonna have to wait a while before you see that.[/i]
[previewyoutube=moBO1Dgy95Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Now for a treat! I've personally been thinking about difficulty, not everyone wants easy levels. So I got our composer working on a song that will be used for a REALLY really hard level. Here is a preview of this song!
[i]trust me, you aren't ready for what I have planned.[/i]
[previewyoutube=FViTnyV4EdI;full][/previewyoutube]

Phew! We're finally done with the music section, I personally believe this section is really important, it's literally the foundation of the entire game!

[h1][b]LOGO UPDATES[/b][/h1]

I also found some time for a little refresh on the game's logo, I haven't finished this just yet, still got some more artwork to make, but who doesn't mind a little sneak preview of the new logo?
Take a look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/88f9075fcd5ce1720ffe069e2fd166b51d77c891.png[/img]

[h1][b]GAME UPDATES[/b][/h1]
Alright, we've delayed enough. What have we done to the actual GAME this month?
Well I'm gonna be honest, not a whole lot is actually finished and ready to show just yet.
We spent a lot of this month outlining what we need to do before launch, which is an important step in game development.

However, I can tell you what we are working on right now, and hopefully show you these next month!

[h2][b]Reworking Core Mechanics[/b][/h2]
As said before, a lot of the core gameplay of Circular Fever is a little outdated, and needs to be reworked. Let me tell you, [b]THIS TAKES A LONG TIME[/b] so I'm still working on this one. But it's looking promising so far!
This is currently my top priority, once this is finished, we can work more on other features.

[h2][b]New Sprites[/b][/h2]
We've refreshed the note sprites for the game! These are actually finished, so I can give you a quick look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841373/bfbc237bef7190f134716343d9a9844e7c7f137f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Customisation[/b][/h2]
Maybe you don't like the new sprites, maybe you just want a change!
We're also working on customising things like: noteskins, hitsounds, hit effects and even more!
More news on this shortly

[h1][b]AND THAT'S A WRAP![/b][/h1]
That's all we got for this month! Sorry there weren't many new things to share, but I hope this was enough to keep you guys content for now.
We're working on this slowly but surely!

Thanks for reading the whole way through! If you haven't already, join the discord!
https://discord.gg/6qDedtKZx7

We'll be providing sneak peeks into development over there!

Also follow us on twitter!
https://twitter.com/Circular_Fever

We post news there, and let you all know about announcements as soon as they happen!

We'll see you next month for another developer update!

notes.title: A Little Update
notes.content:
Hey All!

Thanks for checking out the Demo, and if you've wishlisted the game, thanks a ton!

We've gotten a bit of feedback since the launch, feedback that has made me look back at some of the things we've made for this game, and reconsider it.

One of the biggest points was the song quality. The majority of songs were made by me, but one was made by someone else who is now working on music for the game instead!
The song quality can basically be explained as: I'm not the greatest at making music, and obviously these songs just didn't hit like I wanted them to.

The good news: I'm now working on remaking all the songs in the game with a bit more experience, learning how to use software, what works with what, you get the idea.
Hopefully these versions will be a lot better than the original.

Next up: Game Mechanics.
I want to rework a lot of the systems in the base game, since a lot of them just don't work very well and is very old code from 3 years ago.
We're going to be reworking these systems to make the game a whole lot better, however, that will take a lot of time. I have no idea how long it will take us to learn what we need to in order to develop these systems, let alone actually develop them.

Long story short: We'll be slowing down a bit. But we aren't abandoning this game.

Once again: Thanks for taking an interest into this project!
We're working to improve and make this the game we envisioned from the beginning!

See you on the flipside.
